explanation: Kourovka 20.76 (Pyber) asks whether a finite p-group whose abelian normal subgroups have order ≤ p^k has all abelian subgroups of order ≤ p^{2k}. The Lean negates the universal claim, matching the notebook's (v50) "No" answer. I read Muliarchyk's Proposition 6.1: a 2-group of order 2^145 with abelian normal subgroups ≤ 2^42 and an elementary abelian subgroup of order 2^85 > 2^84. This matches the docstring. The statement is correct and solved.
